digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI workflow and documentation-gate routing
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets currently consume the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, and auxiliary jobs; a trusted classifier must route docs-only changes to a reduced lane that retains all documentation validation gates.

The routing decision must execute only from trusted origin/main with fail-closed semantics: the classifier computes route=full for any non-allowlisted path, missing parent, malformed diff, or classifier failure, ensuring untrusted patchset code never controls Verified gating.

Existing inline documentation gates must be extracted into a single shared composite action at .github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml and invoked by both the docs-only and full routes without adding runner jobs or losing any documentation validation assertions.

The classifier job failure must trigger full-route job execution via always() gating and simultaneously block Verified, preventing an invalid or unverified routing decision from yielding +1 when the fallback graph passes.

Every structural test consumer of gerrit-verify.yaml (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py, test_check_config_reads_heldout.py, test_complexity_baseline.py, test_extra_coverage_guard.py, test_git_floor_gate_tree_skew.py, test_dependency_advisory_wiring.py, test_worktree_python_pin.py) must migrate to follow the extracted action while retaining all documented invariants.

Production operator attestation must record the classifier vote, Verified vote, merge SHA, timestamp, and genuine runner-minutes against the baseline run 31817494677 to confirm the docs-only lane reduces wall-clock and resource consumption without weakening gate coverage.
